notes: The Home Assistant Companion app for Android, on Google Play as io.homeassistant.companion.android and one of the largest actively-maintained open-source Compose codebases: :app alone declares 99 @Preview functions across settings, onboarding, Matter commissioning and the Wear-companion surfaces, with a house theme rather than stock Material. Ordinary Android Compose, single Gradle build at the repository root. One thing a reviewer should know about the build: the root build.gradle.kts calls dependencyLocking { lockAllConfigurations() } and the repository ships gradle.lockfile, so injecting the preview plugin adds modules the lock state does not describe. That is what COMPOSE_PREVIEW_WRITE_LOCKS / --write-locks in the reusable pipeline exists for; nothing is edited in the upstream checkout beyond Gradle regenerating its own lock state for the throwaway build. Licence: Apache-2.0. The build cannot configure without a google-services.json it does not commit: AndroidApplicationConventionPlugin applies the Google Services plugin to every application module, and :app died on processMinimalDebugGoogleServices before a preview was discovered. The pipeline writes a placeholder for the applicationIds named above — both flavours' debug ids are listed, so the stub survives the change of rendered variant described below. They are exact ids because the plugin does no prefix fallback, and they come from the upstream convention plugins (base io.homeassistant.companion.android, flavour suffix .minimal, build-type suffix .debug), not from guesswork. variant is fullDebug rather than the plugin's default debug. :app has minimal and full flavors, so there is no plain debug variant, and app/src/screenshotTest/ — which the preview plugin compiles, because it renders @Preview functions declared there — references SettingsWearOnboardingViewContent, a symbol that exists only in app/src/full/. minimalDebug therefore fails to compile those sources before a preview is rendered; fullDebug builds. stubGoogleServices already names the fullDebug applicationId alongside the minimal one, so the stub needs no change.
